Ask a running proxy for every artifact a lockfile locks, so each is analysed before a client asks for it. The exit code is the OR of 1 for a failure and 2 for an artifact still being analysed, and 4 on its own for an error

Usage: byrle warm [OPTIONS] --lockfile <PATH>

Options:
      --lockfile <PATH>      A lockfile whose artifacts to ask for. Repeatable
      --proxy <URL>          The proxy to ask [default: the proxy URL, or the listen address]
      --platform <PLATFORM>  Ask only for artifacts that install on this platform, <os>-<cpu> or <os>-<cpu>-<libc> in npm's names, such as linux-x64. Repeatable [default: this machine's]
      --all-platforms        Ask for every platform's artifacts
      --deadline <SECONDS>   Stop asking for an artifact still being analysed after this long [default: 900]
  -h, --help                 Print help
